messages:
sarah_cs: weekly private deploy check-in — quick region rundown. TL;DR: EU-west saw a KV cache hit regression causing ~60ms p50 bump; ap-south had transient HSM/KMS timeouts on 03/18; spend +12% MoM from token growth. details below.

mike_ops: saw the eu-west KV issue, root cause = worker OOM during an auto-batch spike. rolled a patch at 10:12 UTC to reduce batch concurrency. metrics look back to baseline.

leo_se: can we pin impacted customers to smaller batch profiles while we validate? @anja_ae which accounts are hit so we can coordinate?

anja_ae: affected: Borealis (eu-west) and Quantacore (eu-west). both on Dedicated. CSMs informed; they're ok with a canary if we need it.

deploy-bot: [10:12 UTC] Patch deployed -> pool-eu-west-1: batch-concurrency 12 -> 8. no rollback.

kms-alert-bot: [03/18 03:04 UTC] KMS: transient HSM kernel timeout detected in ap-south-1. automatic retry succeeded; brief key-usage latency spike.

sarah_cs: ap-south p95 back to normal after retries? any customers still seeing errors?

mike_ops: p95 returned to baseline. small error tail from one customer due to their expired cert — CSM is following up.

leo_se: follow-ups we should track: 1) better KV-cache observability for prefetched prefixes, 2) alert: batch CPU >85% for >2m, 3) customer-scoped KMS retry metrics.

anja_ae: ack. I'll prepare an enablement note for affected accounts and add a renewal-risk flag for Borealis (they pinged about spend).

sarah_cs: action items: Mike -> implement batch CPU alert (ETA 48h). Leo -> add dashboard panel for KV cache hits & KMS retries (ETA 72h). Anja -> customer check-ins this week, collect feedback (ETA EOD Fri). I'll bundle for renewal-risk review.

mike_ops: 👍 starting on the alert, ETA tomorrow morning.

leo_se: drafting dashboard, will share link once live.

anja_ae: reaching out to Borealis + Quantacore now, copying their CSMs. will post responses here.

borealis-csm: Borealis update: acceptance testing slowed; they want a cost breakdown and options (quantize + smaller pool) before committing to renew.

sarah_cs: copy — we'll prepare a cost-impact calc and a quantization recommendation. assigning to @leo_se for quant plan.

leo_se: will propose two options: (1) int8 quant + perf test (est ~3% quality delta), (2) route non-latency-critical traffic to cheaper region. sharing concrete numbers by Thu.

kms-alert-bot: [03/18 03:10 UTC] KMS summary: key rotation success 99.995% over last 7d; no outstanding key faults.

mike_ops: log snippet from eu-west fix for record:
```
2026-03-17T10:11:58Z pool-eu-west-1 batch_worker: OOM at iter 349
2026-03-17T10:12:02Z orchestrator: reduced concurrency -> 8
2026-03-17T10:12:08Z patch applied, health check pass
```

sarah_cs: thanks team. I'll include this in the weekly account notes to PM/eng. anything else to capture?

anja_ae: nothing else right now — posting customer replies as they come in.
